heroHeadline: Day 99: World Cup T-10 Days; CJNG June Attack Surge Peaks at 324 Monthly Strikes; El Sapo At Large
heroSubtitle: Day 99 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG JUNE ATTACK SURGE — PEAK MONTH: Homeland Security Today and the 2026 Jalisco operation record document June 2026 as the highest-attack month of the entire post-Mencho period — 324 CJNG attacks in June alone of 756 total Feb–June, the most intense operational tempo since the February 22 retaliation wave. The surge reflects O3's Grupo Élite territorial consolidation and ongoing Colombian mercenary-assisted offensive in Michoacán. WORLD CUP T-10 DAYS: The FIFA World Cup 2026 opens in 10 days (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Plan Kukulkan's full deployment is locked in: 20,000 Armed Forces, 55,000 federal/state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft/drones. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches beginning June 15) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 99: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — one day before the Day 100 milestone. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 23: 23 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9); no confirmed successor plaza boss. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU: 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives — some with Russia-Ukraine war combat experience — across 10 municipalities in active CJNG offensive (Zamora, Jacona, Tangamandapio, Chilchota, Charapan, Paracho, Cherán, Nahuatzen, Los Reyes, Tangancícuaro). CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 99): Ongoing — 'coordination without subordination' Mullin-Sheinbaum framework active; June bilateral meeting pending. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
